messages:
anna-partnerships: quick ask — I pulled the latest vendor decks and we need canonical inputs for the cost model update. can folks who own vendor relationships drop: SKU, reserved price (term + commit), spot/interrupt price, expected monthly supply (GPU count), regional availability, lead time, and any soft limits? will paste a template below.

mike-finance: +1. finance needs an "amortized $/GPU-hour" or at least $/month + assumed utilization. also please call out any up‑front credits vs monthly commit.

deepak-eng: do we want per-instance type (A100-80GB / H100-80GB) or just family-level numbers? spot preemption rates matter for batching logic.

anna-partnerships: per-instance please. spot preemption we can capture as a percent bucket (0-5%, 5-20%, 20%+). we should also capture whether spot is cross‑region or local.

sophie-product: can we add a column for "marketplace fee" (if they're listing through a cloud marketplace) and expected billing granularity (hour, min, sec)? affects our unit economics.

raj-ops: also include SLA/repair lead time for reserved nodes — some partners give 24–72h replacement windows for hardware faults, that impacts effective availability.

anna-partnerships: copied — here's a tiny CSV snippet you can paste into the sheet:```
vendor,region,sku,term_months,commit_gpus,reserved_price_month,spot_price_hour,expected_monthly_supply_gpus,spot_preempt_pct,marketplace_fee_pct,billing_granularity,lead_time_days,notes
acme,us-west,A100-80GB,12,50,250000,0.45,200,5,8,hour,7,commit includes networking credits
```

mike-finance: perfect. can we also get their "effective capacity" number (peak vs guaranteed) — e.g., they may sell 1k GPUs but only guarantee 300 for reserved. we need that for supply constraints in the price ladder.

deepak-eng: for the modeling side I'll assume: reserved instances → fixed allocation, spot → best-effort with preemptions modeled as loss of 1-2x batch work. if partners give an SLO for preemptions we can weight cost by wasted work. put that in the notes column.

anna-partnerships: action items: everyone owning a partner — drop the CSV rows into the shared sheet by EOD Tue. i'll consolidate and send to modeling. tagging @mike-finance for the amortized calc. :raised_hands:

marketplace-bot: new file uploaded — "vendor_cost_inputs_q2.csv" by anna-partnerships (link: https://redwood.internal/sheets/vendor_cost_inputs_q2)

raj-ops: quick Q — for partners who offer "reserved + spot pool" combos, do we want to model blended pricing or keep separate lines?

sophie-product: blended is useful for high-level: show "blended $/GPUhr at X% reserved" curves. keep raw lines too for sensitivity.

mike-finance: agreed. final ask: please call out any promotional pricing timelines (e.g., first 3 months at -20%) so we can time promotions.

anna-partnerships: thanks all — i'll run a preliminary pass after EOD Tue and post a short summary with 3 candidate ladders (optimistic / base / conservative). :thumbsup:
